card.name: Separators just before a digit
card.fires_on: A period, space, dash or digit that comes right before another number, mostly in section cross-references like (5.7) or (2.4, 12.3) and in number lists.

modes.label: Section reference dots
modes.description: The period inside a numbered section cross-reference in parentheses.

modes.label: Space or dash before a number
modes.description: A space, comma gap or dash that comes before the next number in a list or range.

card.writes: It suppresses the digits 3 to 9, so the next character is less likely to be one of those digits.
card.plain: It marks the point after a section number's dot or a number list's gap, where another digit is about to follow.
